guideNudge.message: New to GitDesktop? The built-in guide walks through the whole workflow.

hero.description: Open a repository to start reviewing, committing, and shipping.
hero.descriptionWithAi: Open a repository to start reviewing, committing, and shipping — with AI in the loop when you want it.
hero.dragHint: …or drag a repo folder anywhere onto the window.

recent.heading: Repositories
recent.emptyDescription: Open, clone, or create a repository and it’ll show up here for quick access.

gitMissing.title: Git not found
gitMissing.description: GitDesktop needs the git command-line tool on your PATH. Install it, then retry.

create.title: Create a new repository
create.description: Initializes a git repository on the "{{branch}}" branch (change in Settings).
create.name: Name
create.pathPlaceholder: Type, paste, or choose a folder…
create.initializeReadme: Initialize this repository with a README

clone.title: Clone a repository
clone.description: Pick one of your GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repositories, or paste a URL. Clones over HTTPS or SSH using your system git credentials.
clone.destinationPlaceholder: Choose a folder to clone into…
clone.submodulesDescription: Initializes every submodule, including nested ones, after cloning.

bitbucket.title: Connect your Bitbucket account
bitbucket.description: Add an Atlassian API token in Settings → Accounts to browse your Bitbucket repositories, or clone from a URL instead.

errors.choosePath: Choose a local path to clone into
errors.enterUrl: Enter a repository URL to clone
errors.installCli: Install the {{cli}} and run {{authCmd}} to browse your repositories, or clone from a URL instead.
